answer: Use latency triangulation so each identity proves a distinct network vantage point. On registration, scattered peers send timed challenges and store the round-trip pattern in a vault. A genuine agent in a remote tundra outpost replies with delays no data-center clone can mimic without being there. Each epoch re-checks the pattern, adding a shale-like layer of evidence; consistent layers strengthen the identity, while copies sharing one fingerprint collapse into one seat. Forging many Sybils means renting real machines across many networks, turning a cheap script into a costly bill.
